data.name: Patriot Jet Boat Thrill Ride
data.headline: A jet boat tour full of speed, screams and splashes | Must be 48" tall
data.description:
#*A turbo-charged tour of San Diego's most scenic waterfront spots!*

Get ready for screams, speed and splashes on a high-speed tour of San Diego Bay.  There's nothing like it!

meeting_point.address: 990 N Harbor Dr San Diego, CA US 92101

data.what_is_included:
30 minute tour on open-air jet boat
High-speed spins, tricks, and turns
Spectacular San Diego views

data.cancellation_notes:
#Reservations Policy
Reservations are non-refundable. Please provide Flagship with 24-hour notice prior to the cruise date to reschedule your cruise to another time and date.
data.booking_notes:
#Details

•**Each member of your party are required to sign a waiver for this event. You WILL NOT be allowed to board without signing the waiver.  A waiver form will be sent to you shortly following this confirmation.  Once received please fill out one waiver per guest. Please have ID ready upon check-in. Any questions regarding the waiver, please contact us at 1-619-234-4111.**

•Flagship will gladly add additional tickets to your existing reservation. If you desire to be seated with someone who holds an existing reservation, our reservation department would be pleased to accommodate your request, call us at 1-619-234-4111.

•Our Captains & Crews want you to enjoy your experience with Flagship. Please be aware, parking downtown is limited. Please be sure to allow enough travel time to arrive at our docks 30 minutes before your scheduled departure time.

•Flagship Cruises & Events accepts no responsibility for loss, damaged or stolen property on board our vessels or on premises.

•Riders of the Patriot will be exposed to forces, speeds and other intense features that may cause distress or injury to persons with pre-existing health conditions.  Please consider these factors in determining suitability for all riders.  Only guests in good health should ride the Patriot.  **For your safety do not ride if you are pregnant, have high blood pressure, motion sickness, heart, neck or back problems, recent surgery or any other medical condition that might be aggravated by the forces of the Patriot**.

•Patriot Access:  All guests, including those with disabilities or use a wheelchair, must be able to transfer into and out of the Patriot by themselves.

#Taxes and Fees
• Fees - A  6% convenience fee charged for the convenience of booking online.

#Additional Info
Your experience is important to us. If you have any questions regarding this confirmation or your reservation, please contact our reservation department at 1-619-234-4111 during regular business hours 8am – 5:30pm PST daily.

On behalf of our entire crew…WELCOME ABOARD Flagship Cruises & Events!

data.disclaimers:
- Must be 48" (122 cm) or taller to ride. Minors must be accompanied by an adult.

- For your safety do not ride if you are pregnant, have high blood pressure, heart, neck or back problems, have had recent surgery, are prone to motion sickness or any other medical condition that might be aggravated by the speed and forces of the Patriot.

- **Waiver must be signed by each passenger 18+ years. Children under 17 years must have waiver signed by an Adult 18+ years.
